name: Line Furniture
note: line.com.sa is a live Riyadh-based broad home/furniture e-commerce store (13+ categories incl. sofas, dining, lighting, decor, fragrances; working cart, SAR pricing) plus a physical Riyadh showroom (founded 2017). Approved category, Saudi HQ confirmed.

name: KH Perfumes | عطور كي إتش
note: perfumekh.com does not resolve on repeated attempts and has no indexed storefront; the only confirmable presence is a 'Construction' placeholder Salla page and a 130-follower Instagram, i.e. a micro-operation with no verifiable live substantial catalog (fails scale/live-channel).

name: rihafbeauty
note: Domain won't resolve and is barely indexed; could not independently confirm SKU scale, catalog breadth, or single-vs-multi-brand, and one source describes it as a 'shopping experience in UAE,' putting the Saudi-HQ claim in genuine doubt. Does not clear the clean-Yes bar.

name: SPAR QATAR
note: SPAR International confirms the Qatar operator is Al Wataniya International Holding, a Doha-based licensee running 6 hypermarkets with live QAR online grocery (plus Snoonu/Talabat). Grocery approved, operator genuinely HQ'd in Qatar; dead sparqatar.shop is a valid relocation to spar-qatar.com.

name: Oncost Trading Company
note: Confirmed as Kuwait's leading family grocer with ~20-23 stores (retail/wholesale/express formats), Kuwait-HQ'd (Hawalli, est. 2010), live oncost.com KWD online grocery. Substantial dedicated retail arm alongside the wholesale line.

name: Mazaya Food
note: Saudi-HQ'd in Qatif, operating the Mazaya Hyper physical hypermarket (premium retail + bakery) plus the online Mazaya Store (general merchandise/grocery). Approved category, substantial dedicated retail arm despite a coexisting food-distribution line.

name: Tawseel Media Group
note: This is Taw9eel/Tawseel Holding, Kuwait's largest online retailer (80,000+ products across groceries/electronics/fashion, 30-min delivery), Kuwait-HQ'd. Massive-scale general-merchandise e-commerce; the 'media/construction' tags were misnomers.

name: wecre8
note: wecre8.com is genuinely live (indexed Shopify men/women/product collections, Arab News coverage) as a Riyadh fashion concept store showcasing 200+ Saudi designers plus Nike/Adidas, with physical concept stores and an app. Fashion approved, Saudi HQ confirmed.

name: Gift Mart International
note: Core is gift manufacturing and corporate/executive (B2B) gifting (factories in KSA/Lebanon/China, 700+ staff); the consumer arm is a few boutiques plus a single-concept e-commerce (Artfeena custom photo-to-drawings, Tejouree limited-edition artifact replicas), a narrow low-repeat niche, not the substantial broad approved-category retail arm the corrected Gate 2 requires.

name: INTERTEC GROUP W.L.L.
note: Qatar-HQ'd (Doha, 33 years) running 10+ consumer-electronics retail showrooms across Qatar (Mi/Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor in major malls) plus e-commerce, alongside its distribution arm. Approved electronics category, substantial retail arm (Lazurde/Al Andalus hybrid pattern).

name: Video Home & Electronic Centre
note: Operating entity is Video Home & Electronic Centre WLL, founded Doha 1980 by Qatari founders and genuinely Qatar-HQ'd (distinct from the UAE Jumbo Group), running 13+ electronics showrooms (Jumbo Electronics, LG, Harman House) plus own e-commerce (jumbosouq.com) and app. Approved category, substantial retail arm despite distribution/MEP lines.

name: Manuel Market
note: Jeddah-HQ'd luxury supermarket chain with 12+ stores across Jeddah/Riyadh/Jubail, online grocery delivery and a Google Play app. Approved grocery category, Saudi HQ, multiple physical stores; the DNS-fail was an artifact and the business is current.

name: miraymano
note: Curated multi-brand fashion boutique born and HQ'd in Riyadh (founded 2017) with a verified physical store (address/hours/reviews) plus a live Shopify store (abayas, bags, jewelry, perfume) with unified SAR checkout and own delivery. First-party curated department-store model, not an excluded aggregator; small but genuine omnichannel retailer.

name: RIS Group
note: ris.co is a live broad Saudi furniture/home-decor e-commerce store (catalog spanning 11+ pages, working cart, free delivery over 1200 SAR) with a Jeddah showroom, established 2002, Saudi-HQ'd. Approved category; substantial dedicated retail arm despite a coexisting interior-design/B2B line (Lazurde pattern).
